gyroid_solid_mask — 3D surface op

• Data kinds: कोई नहीं → voxel (केवल arguments से तय होने वाला op — यह कोई image या data input नहीं लेता)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.gyroid_solid_mask(shape=(64, 64, 64), level=0.0, periods=1.0, thickness=0.3) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import render3d; render3d.gyroid_solid_mask(shape=(64, 64, 64), level=0.0, periods=1.0, thickness=0.3), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("gyroid_solid_mask"))

उपयोग

printable solid के रूप में gyroid: level set के ±*thickness* के अंदर का shell।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Returns a volume (float 0/1), so it feeds the existing voxel ops (vol_label / skeletonize_vol / mesh_slice_stack) directly and needs no marching cubes —— this form works on bare numpy, while gyroid_isosurface needs scikit-image.

★Why this earns its place: at level = 0 the field is odd under the body-centred inversion, so the solid fraction of the two sides is *exactly* equal —— a symmetry fact the mask can be checked against (the measured fraction above 0 converges on 0.5 as the grid refines), and the shell volume grows linearly in *thickness* for small *thickness* because the level set has finite area. Both are independent of how the field was sampled.

Raises ValueError: a grid below 8 per axis or over the cap; non-positive periods; a non-finite level; a negative thickness.
